template.title: The Missing Star Puzzle
template.summary: A gentle story about a child finding a missing puzzle piece with the help of a friendly animal.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the park.
One day, the toy was a picture of the sun, but one bright yellow star piece was missing.
The child looked around and wondered where the piece had gone.
She almost decided to throw the puzzle away, but then thought of her friend [[slot_pet]].
She called out, "Hello [[slot_pet]], can you see the missing star?"
The [[slot_pet]] sniffed the air and trotted to the big oak tree.
Under the tree, the star piece glowed like a tiny sunrise.
The child reached out and placed the piece into the picture.
The sun picture shone brighter, and the park felt warmer.
They celebrated with a crunchy [[slot_snack]] and laughed together.
